artifacts.title: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026 Structured Data
artifacts.summary: Canonical structured source for current FedRAMP rules, definitions, applicability, effective dates, certification classes, and update history.
artifacts.provenance_note: FedRAMP directs automation and AI agents to this dataset instead of the rendered HTML site. Control Atlas validates the retrieved JSON against the official schema before deriving transition links.
artifacts.license_or_use_note: Official FedRAMP public source data. FedRAMP names and marks remain GSA property.
limitations: A ruleset-level status or date does not replace rule-specific applicability, class variants, effective dates, or related definitions.

artifacts.title: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules Dataset Schema
artifacts.summary: Official JSON Schema defining the expected structure of the consolidated rules dataset.
artifacts.provenance_note: Control Atlas uses this schema to reject a malformed or structurally incompatible rules refresh.
artifacts.license_or_use_note: Official FedRAMP public source data. FedRAMP names and marks remain GSA property.
limitations: Schema validity confirms structure, not that a selected rule applies to a specific organization or certification profile.

artifacts.title: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026 JSON Schema Index
artifacts.summary: Official index of machine-readable submission schemas governed by the FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026.
artifacts.provenance_note: Use the dated schemas and FedRAMP changelog together; field names can change between releases.
artifacts.license_or_use_note: Published by GSA for FedRAMP submissions. FedRAMP names and marks remain GSA property.
limitations: This index does not replace the related FedRAMP rules.

artifacts.title: FedRAMP Legacy Assets Combined Archive

Confirm the applicable 2026 rules before using any enclosed template.

artifacts.title: GSA FedRAMP Automation OSCAL Archive

artifacts.license_or_use_note: U.S. Government work dedicated worldwide under CC0 1.0; patent and trademark rights are unaffected.
limitations: Archived July 1, 2025 and no longer maintained.
Do not treat its OSCAL files or validation rules as current 2026 submission requirements.

artifacts.title: MITRE eMASS API OpenAPI Schema
